finalText:
Two tests failed out of 700, both in `auth/tokens.test.js`:

1. `refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token` (line 400)
2. `sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback` (line 650)

Everything else — 698 tests — passed clean. Worth a look at that token-revocation one first, it sounds like an auth bug rather than a flaky test.
